sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate explicitly associates protection evidence with each applicable hazard and associated equipment item, so no canonical match is verified.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The graph is not semantically faithful: the ship-level hazardProtectionCoverage=true is an unconnected presence/value check that can pass without demonstrating coverage for each machinery installation and its associated equipment. Encode the complete per-installation hazard-coverage requirement rather than relying on this global boolean, and ensure the protection evidence relationship covers the associated equipment as well as the installation.
